attributes.name: ypy-nonce
attributes.description: Marks a YPY element as server-rendered trusted markup: its value must equal the page nonce, or `ypy-csp` strips every `ypy-*` and `data-ypy-*` attribute from the element. Only the element's own attribute counts, never an inherited one.

events.name: ypy:security:strip
events.description: Fires on an element after `ypy-csp` removed its `ypy-*` and `data-ypy-*` attributes because it carried no valid nonce.

events.name: ypy:security:violation
events.description: Fires when `ypy-csp` stops an action: code evaluated without a valid nonce (`nonce-mismatch-at-eval`), a `javascript:` or `js:` action URL (`javascript-url`) or a boosted form whose submitter changed `formaction` without a nonce (`unnonced-submitter`).

config.name: nonce
config.description: Requires the `ypy-csp` extension: until it has started, YPY processes no element and sends no request. The page also needs a script with a CSP nonce, and the `ypy` Trusted Types policy when the CSP enforces them.

config.name: safeEval
config.description: Replaces `Function` and `AsyncFunction` with nonce-based script injection, so `ypy-on`, `js:` values and `ypy-confirm` code run without `unsafe-eval` in the CSP. Needs `ypy-csp`.
